brief: AI-native ERP for professional camera and equipment rental houses, built on ERPNext. Dense, calm and trustworthy: the assistant suggests, the human decides.
criteria: Recognisable at 16 px in the Desk navbar and browser tab, works in one colour and reversed, distinct from blue AI marks, no violet or glow.

concepts.name: Return ring
concepts.idea: An open ring: equipment leaves and comes back; the unit sits in the gap.
rationale: A C for Cortex that is one shape, so it holds at 16 px
The dot is the single accent: the item in motion, the human decision
Reads calm and operational, with none of the sparkle or glow of AI marks

recommendation: Return ring, with a heavier small-size cut for favicon and app icon.
next_steps: Replace the placeholder logo in the app
Apply the guidelines in the Desk and the SPA
